Kit summary

Holy ArbitramentBasicExclusive Lv.1
Deals 380% DEF DMG to a single enemy. If Nordak has [Divine Light], deals extra DMG equal to 40% of his total Shield value (up to 150% of self Max HP).
Judgment Lv.1When Nordak has [Divine Light], the extra DMG dealt by Holy Arbitrament will be the sum of 60% of Nordak's total Shield value and 30% of all allies' (excluding self) total Shield value instead (up to 500% of self Max HP).
Holy ShieldActive
Cleanses all attribute debuffs from all allies and grants them a [Shield] respectively by 60% of Nordak's Max HP for 2 turns.
Holy CreaturePassiveExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3
At the beginning of each wave, grants all allies a [Divine Shield] equal to 18% of Nordak's Max HP. [Divine Shield] cannot be stacked, removed, or stolen. All allies will be regranted a [Divine Shield] when their turns end if Nordak is still alive. Nordak will gain 1 layer of [Divine Light] when he gains [Divine Shield] each time. [Divine Light]: Deals extra DMG equal to 40% of self total Shield value when casting Holy Arbitrament.
Judgment Lv.2Nordak gains 1 layer of [Divine Dust] when any ally gains any type of [Shield], up to 100 layers. Each layer of [Divine Dust] will increase 0.4% Shield Effect. Nordak will gain 1 extra layer of [Divine Dust] if the ally's [Shield] is granted by him.
Judgment Lv.3At the beginning of each wave, grants all allies [Overflowing Light] if Nordak is still alive. Increases the Max HP Cap of allies with [Overflowing Light] by 35% of Nordak's initial Max HP Cap. After Nordak acts for 3 turns or he dies for the first time, the bonus effect will be increasing the Max HP Cap of all allies with [Overflowing Light] by 15% of Nordak's initial Max HP Cap instead. If the ally with [Overflowing Light] dies for the first time, the bonus effect of [Overflowing Light] owned by the ally will be increasing by 15% of Nordak's initial Max HP Cap instead.
Holy ShelterActive
Grants all allies [DMG Immunity] and [Block Debuff] for 2 turns, and shares all self buffs with all allies.
